model: myRoom XC BACnet (system and area devices)
equipment_type: Hospitality lighting and HVAC control system (BACnet IP)
applies_to: Lutron myRoom XC hospitality guestroom systems with BACnet integration (Lutron Designer projects); one system device plus one virtual device per area.
summary: The myRoom XC processor speaks BACnet IP. A system device carries the master load-shed object, and each guestroom area is a virtual device with lighting state, scene, occupancy, guest presence, lighting power and the Palladiom thermostat's HVAC zone objects (temperature, humidity, mode, fan, setpoint and drift).
notes: BV 2 Master Load Shed Enabled sits on the system device of the main processor only; all other objects are on each area virtual device.
Names in braces ({HVACZoneName}, {SceneName}) take the names set in Lutron Designer.
Unknown (256) is a transitional state after a power cycle.
HVAC temperature, humidity and fan state are written by Lutron when an FCU controller or VRV/VRF interface is wired to the Palladiom thermostat; otherwise the HVAC system must write them over BACnet.
Occupancy State (MV 8) is the sensor status; Guest Presence Detection State (MV 20) is the room's guest presence.

source.title: BACnet PIC Statement for myRoom XC

integration.summary: Each guestroom area is a virtual BACnet device behind the myRoom XC processor. Read guest presence (MV 20) and occupancy (MV 8), command the thermostat mode (MV 7106), setpoint (AV 7114) and fan mode (MV 7108), and select lighting scenes (MV 4). If no FCU controller or VRF interface is wired to the Palladiom thermostat, the BMS must write the zone temperature, humidity and fan state.

integration.enable: BACnet integration is a licensed feature set up in Lutron Designer; there is no BMS enable point.
integration.remote_sensors: If no FCU controller or VRV/VRF interface is connected directly to the Palladiom thermostat, the HVAC system must write zone temperature (AV 7100/7103), humidity (AV 7120) and fan state (MV 7109) for display on the thermostat. Otherwise Lutron writes them and they are read-only to the BMS.
setup: BACnet IP; area devices are virtual devices routed behind the processor's physical device.
The processor can register as a foreign device with a BBMD.
Lutron's BACnet report from Designer shows which processor is the main one (it carries BV 2).
gotchas: Lighting Scene reads Unknown when the room is not in a defined preset.
Celsius and Fahrenheit objects exist side by side; map one set only.
Writing BV 2 sheds lighting load in every area of the system.
